text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was suddenly entered into the 
Takarazuka Kinen. While medium distance 
will be a challenge for Nishino Flower...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Could you give me a slap on the 
back?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Taiki-senpai taught me before that getting 
a good pat on the back really fires you 
up!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I really want to do my best in today's 
race! I want to become someone who can run 
2200m, too...!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: So please, give it a good *snap*!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower's eyes sparkled with 
anticipation. It would feel awful to let 
her down, so...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, you're so kind, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
With this, even against those "wonderful 
ladies"... I won't... won't lose.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I won't lose...! I know I won't...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yes, today's race lineup is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—Running alongside everyone again... It 
has been since 'spring', has it not?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah. She was really incredible.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: None of us could reach her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Since then, I have reexamined myself 
and retrained.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to make a bold declaration. Right 
now, what I must confront is my past 
self...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The trophy that slipped through my fingers 
before shall finally be mine this time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, McQueen really is so cool, isn't 
she?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Surpassing yourself goes for me too, 
though. That trophy is gonna be mine!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I won't let you all take all the glorious 
titles for yourselves.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day... I will be the one 
victorious.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(The older girls really are amazing... 
Breaking into their ranks is gonna be 
super tough.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (It's tough, but...!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Pop!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, everyone! I'm looking forward to 
working with you today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. You have such wonderful eyes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to our time together, 
Flower-san. —Please delight both my eyes 
and my heart.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes!
